title: CMS blocks
description: Manage storefront content blocks and their display order.

help.title: About home page blocks
help.overview: CMS blocks are the sections of your shop's home page, such as a banner, a slider or an announcement bar. Pick a type, then fill in what it asks for.

sections.title: Types
items: Banners, sliders and promotional sections show pictures with a headline and a button link.
Featured collection, trending, best sellers, flash sale, grid and category showcase show products from a collection or categories.
The announcement bar shows a short message; video shows a video link; custom HTML shows your own code, with anything unsafe removed.

sections.title: When and where it shows
items: A block shows only while it's active and between its start and end dates.
Position sets its order on the page; Reorder blocks lets you drag them into place.
Visibility can limit a block to some devices or regions. Deactivate hides a block without deleting it.

reorderDescription: Drag blocks to change their display order on the storefront.
